arxiv-2005-14098.title: Exact Method for Generating Strategy-Solvable Sudoku Clues
arxiv-2005-14098.creator: Kohei Nishikawa, Takahisa Toda
arxiv-2005-14098.description: Abstract . A Sudoku puzzle often has a regular pattern in the arrangement of initial digits and it is typically made solvable with known solving techniques, called strategies. In this paper, we consider the problem of generating such Sudoku instances. We introduce a rigorous framework to discuss solvability for Sudoku instances with respect to strategies.

arxiv-2106-14355.title: ω \omega -Symplectic algebra and Hamiltonian vector fields Email address: phbaptistelli@uem.br (corresponding author), merhernandes@uem.br Email address: eralcilene.terezio@unila.edu.br
arxiv-2106-14355.creator: Patrícia H. Baptistelli, Maria Elenice R. Hernandes, Eralcilene Moreira Terezio
arxiv-2106-14355.description: Abstract The purpose of this paper is presenting an algebraic theoretical basis for the study of ω \omega -Hamiltonian vector fields. We introduce the concepts of ω \omega -symplectic group and ω \omega -semisymplectic group, and describe some of their properties.

arxiv-2112-05664.title: Leveraging Joint-Diagonalization in Transform-Learning NMF
arxiv-2112-05664.creator: Sixin Zhang, Emmanuel Soubies, Cédric Févotte
arxiv-2112-05664.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sixin Zhang, Emmanuel Soubies, Cédric Févotte. Non-negative matrix factorization with transform learning (TL-NMF) is a recent idea that aims at learning data representations suited to NMF. In this work, we relate TL-NMF to the classical matrix joint-diagonalization (JD) problem. We show that, when the number of data realizations is sufficiently large, TL-NMF can be replaced by a two-step approach—termed as JD+NMF—that estimates the transform through JD, prior to NMF computation.

arxiv-2112-11319.title: 3D arrangement of epitaxial graphene conformally grown on porousified crystalline SiC
arxiv-2112-11319.creator: S. Veronesi, G. Pfusterschmied, F. Fabbri, M. Leitgeb, O. Arif, D.A. Arenas, S. Bals, U. Schmid, S. Heun
arxiv-2112-11319.description: Abstract Nanoporous materials represent a versatile solution for a number of applications ranging from sensing, energy applications, catalysis, drug delivery, and many others. The synergy between the outstanding properties of graphene with a three-dimensional porous structure, circumventing the limits of its 2D nature, constitutes therefore a breakthrough for many fields.

arxiv-2210-05430.description: Abstract The goal of a LLRF system is to control an actual RF cavity with beam. While digital simulations have a place, having an analog circuit to stand in for the cavity can be tremendously helpful in validating hardware+firmware+software under development. A wide range of cavity emulators have been developed in collaboration with SLAC, and LBNL.

arxiv-2301-04751.title: Artificial Intelligence Generated Coins for Size Comparison
arxiv-2301-04751.creator: Gerald Artner
arxiv-2301-04751.description: Abstract Authors of scientific articles use coins in photographs as a size reference for objects. For this purpose, coins are placed next to objects when taking the photo. In this letter we propose a novel method that uses artificial intelligence (AI) generated images of coins to provide a size reference in photos.

arxiv-2306-12773.title: Noninvertibility and non-Markovianity of quantum dynamical maps
arxiv-2306-12773.creator: Vinayak Jagadish, R. Srikanth, Francesco Petruccione
arxiv-2306-12773.description: Abstract We identify two broad types of noninvertibilities in quantum dynamical maps, one necessarily associated with CP indivisibility and one not so. We study the production of (non-)Markovian, invertible maps by the process of mixing noninvertible Pauli maps, and quantify the fraction of the same.

arxiv-2407-17202.title: Partitioning of total charge in matter from geometric phases of electrons
arxiv-2407-17202.creator: Joyeta Saha, Sujith Nedungattil Subrahmanian, Joydeep Bhattacharjee School of Physical Sciences National Institute of Science Education and Research, A CI of Homi Bhabha National Institute, Odisha - 752050, India

Based on geometric phases of Bloch electrons computed from first-principles, we propose a scheme for unambiguous partitioning of charge in matter, derivable directly from the Kohn-Sham states.

arxiv-2502-03067.description: Abstract Maintaining grid stability amid widespread electric vehicle (EV) adoption is vital for sustainable transportation.
